benchmark.name: NVIDIA RULER v1
benchmark.caveat: Three samples per task from one sealed seed improve coverage over the prior one-sample milestone but do not provide a population-level confidence interval.

oracle_diagnostic_on_failed_tasks.scope: the nine samples in niah_multivalue, qa_1, and qa_2 only
oracle_diagnostic_on_failed_tasks.interpretation: QA-2 was a hybrid dependency-retrieval gap; multi-value remained an exhaustive-relation gap even with oracle locations; QA-1 retained the facts but did not preserve the exact answer punctuation.

official_evaluation.schema_compatibility_shim: The pinned generator omits the evaluator's required others object. Evaluation used copies with only others:{} added; all other fields were verified identical after deleting that field.

failure_analysis_and_fixes.failure: Top-k replay exposed only two of four values for one explicit key.
failure_analysis_and_fixes.fix: An exhaustive plural lookup now scans immutable raw evidence by the query-derived exact key, compiles every resolved value with exact pointers, and fails closed if its bounded scan saturates.

failure_analysis_and_fixes.failure: A relational question found the film-to-person fact but not the person's separate biography.
failure_analysis_and_fixes.fix: The recursive controller now extracts at most two proper-name bridge candidates near relation verbs in high-overlap source sentences and pages them in for one bounded natural-language dependency round.

failure_analysis_and_fixes.failure: A factually correct list changed source punctuation, and an ambiguous office question discarded a second valid source span.
failure_analysis_and_fixes.fix: The answer contract preserves source-exact spelling, punctuation, and order and retains every distinct exact span satisfying an ambiguous relation.

anti_reward_hacking.non_claim: This is not proof of native 256K attention, broad domain generalization, learned latent-memory fidelity, or effectively unbounded context.
